messages.subject: Requiring login for JIRA comments
parts:
Hi

We've had some spam comments show up on our JIRA issues recently. In order to handle this, I've disabled anonymous comment posting on the SparkR JIRA. 

The only change for already registered users on the JIRA is that you'll need to login before posting a comment.

Let me know if something doesn't work as expected.

Thanks
Shivaram
